claims.claim: Qorvo's FY2026 revenue fell 1.1% to $3.6785B while gross margin improved to 45.9% from 41.3%, consistent with deliberate exit from lower-margin mass-market Android exposure and stronger HPA mix.
Qorvo remains subject to a pending Skyworks combination expected to close in early 2027, making standalone strategy and capital allocation transitional.

factors.name: mix quality
factors.basis: Primary 10-K shows substantial gross-margin improvement despite slightly lower revenue.

factors.name: corporate transition
factors.basis: Pending merger can add scale but makes standalone expectations less durable.

risks.risk: Merger approvals and closing conditions remain external dependencies.

unknowns.unknown: Post-merger product rationalization and synergy realization are not yet observable.

claims.claim: FY2026 operating cash flow rose to $808.6M from $622.2M and Q4 free cash flow was $255M, providing hard execution evidence alongside margin repair.
Qorvo discontinued forward guidance and earnings calls because of the pending Skyworks transaction, reducing normal standalone expectation visibility.

factors.name: cash conversion
factors.basis: Primary filings show stronger operating cash generation.

factors.name: expectation visibility
factors.basis: Forward guidance discontinued during pending transaction.

risks.risk: Standalone forecasts are unusually uncertain while merger closing remains pending.

unknowns.unknown: No Scout valuation conclusion is asserted.
